Rule.name: LDAP ApacheDS - Customization
Rule.Description:
Runs for every account read during LDAP ApacheDS aggregation. One connection is reused for the whole aggregation.
1. Groups: looks up the groups whose uniqueMember contains the account DN and puts them in "groups", so the IT roles are detected as met.
2. Account status, from the ApacheDS password policy attribute pwdAccountLockedTime (an operational attribute, so it is read by name): not present -> accountStatus = Active 000001010000Z -> accountStatus = Disabled (admin lock) IIQDisabled = true any other timestamp -> accountStatus = Locked (failed logins) IIQLocked = true Also brings back pwdChangedTime, pwdFailureTime, createTimestamp and modifyTimestamp, formatted as DD-MM-YYYY HH:mm:ss UTC.
